title: Cherry tomato eggs with spinach and feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole, recognisable food: tomatoes, spinach, spring onions, garlic, eggs, feta, olive oil and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or similar, and nothing is a treat purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large frying pan with a lid, and cracking eggs into hollows is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 500g tomatoes, 100g spinach and 8 eggs make a sensible two-egg breakfast each for four, and 5 to 6 minutes covered will set the whites without burning the jammy base.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers halving 500g of cherry tomatoes and slicing the onions and garlic, and the steps add up to about 15 to 17 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including basil and chilli flakes, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Jammy June cherry tomatoes form the base of the dish, which suits a summer morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that reads like a neighbour explaining it.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, vegetables and feta make a proper, protein-rich breakfast a family would happily repeat.
